front: the peer-adoption condition: the membership conversation that makes the client believe a peer is present (push -> include/pace -> gain), which precedes any creation attempt
note: edit this file when the front moves; the dashboard renders whatever is declared and flags it stale when STATE.md has newer verdicts

counters.name: peer rows included
counters.why: the peer's row was included in a membership body the client received

counters.name: peer rows paced
counters.why: the duty-cycle is pacing peer-row pushes (the landing fix)

counters.name: peer rows gained
counters.why: the client gained the peer row (the pairing event)

counters.name: membership replications
counters.why: type-12 membership replication bodies pushed (the peer-carrier class)

counters.name: creation attempts failed
counters.why: the client tried to build an entity and failed - the front's goal signal
